atoms.text: There are different kinds of thermometers. Select the thermometer at the top.
For example, the thermometer at the top is usually used to measure the temperature in a room or how warm it is outside. Now Select the thermometer on the left.
Thermometers that look like the one on the left are usually used to measure the temperature of engines and machinery. Now Select the thermometer on the right.
You might recognise the type of thermometer on the right. It is used to measure body temperature. You use this when you have a fever.

instruction.text: Which thermometer would you use to measure the temperature? Drag the thermometer to the correct picture.

hint.text: Select the pictures to learn which thermometer goes with which object.

a.sound: Rory has a fever. His temperature needs to be measured.

b.sound: This thermometer can be used to measure body temperature.

a.sound: Alexandra needs to measure the temperature of her car.

b.sound: This thermometer can be used to measure the temperature of machinery.

instruction.text: Which thermometer would you use to measure the temperature? Drag the thermometer to the correct picture.

hint.text: Select the pictures to learn which thermometer goes with which object.

a.sound: Sam is feeling poorly. His temperature needs to be measured.

b.sound: This thermometer can be used to measure body temperature.

a.sound: The kitchen is a little cold. The temperature needs to be checked.

b.sound: This thermometer can be used to measure how warm a room is.

instruction.text: Which thermometer would you use to measure the temperature? Drag the thermometer to the correct picture.

hint.text: Select the pictures to learn which thermometer goes with which object.

a.sound: The washing machine is too hot. The temperature needs to be measured.

b.sound: This thermometer can be used to measure the temperature of machinery.

a.sound: It looks warm outside. The thermometer will show the temperature.

b.sound: This thermometer can be used to measure how warm it is outside.
